description.value: 5Bean Brewbar & Café is a locally-owned specialty coffee shop in Kamloops serving beans from JJ Bean and Phil & Sebastian roasters alongside fresh baking, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and desserts. The business operates two locations — one on the Northshore and one in Sahali — making it a potential stop at multiple points on a Kamloops-area ride. A rewards card program gives a free drink after every 10 purchases.
